description: Publishing. Every change to an app (uploads, edit_file replaces, update_app settings, retheme…) and every change from the dashboard waits in the app's draft: nobody sees it, not the users and not pre's testers. Nothing is published on its own; "publish" sends the whole draft. The app's own settings (name, slug, publishing, bans, team, domains) are not in the draft: they change at once. Each app has a chosen environment, `target`: "pro" (the default: what the users have) or "pre" (a private copy the developer tests calmly, at the pre link, with its own data and Stripe's test mode). Actions: "publish" — the whole draft at once to the target. With target "pro" the users get it right now (returns { published, target, live: true, promotedAt, files, settings, message }). With target "pre" only pre gets it (live: false). A publish costs no credits; with target "pro" it is one more version in "releases". A rooms change that discards data saved in pro needs confirmRoomsChange (error rooms_data_loss, nothing changed). "discard" — throw the draft away; the app stays as it was (irreversible). "to_pre" — "Move to pre": from now on publishes go to pre only (for a redesign tried with the test card 4242 before the users see it). "promote" — "Move to pro": all of pre goes to pro at once and the target goes back to "pro" (with target "pro" it is the same as "publish"). "reset" — "Discard" pre: pre goes back to what the users have and the target to "pro", without sending anything. "rollback" (releaseId) — send an earlier version back to pro, whole, at once (same answer as a publish to pro). The draft and pre are not touched. A rooms change that discards saved data needs confirmRoomsChange. In git, each environment is a branch (the developer's repo when linked with neblla_git, else Neblla's, see neblla_versions): when a version reaches pro, pre's branch is merged into pro's. The moderators follow the data, like the players: a pre on pro's data has pro's, a pre with its own data its own (neblla_set_moderator). The actions that only look (status, diff, releases) are in neblla_promote_read.

confirmRoomsChange.description: For "publish", "promote" and "rollback": accept a rooms change that discards data saved in pro
